en.title: Full Stack Developer
en.stack: NestJS, Next.js, GraphQL, REST APIs, SQL Server, Azure, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Kubernetes

items: Built REST APIs and GraphQL services with NestJS, including resolver and query performance work.
Designed the GraphQL APIs of My Team Dashboard, which aggregates business KPIs, and deployed its microservices on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Built Next.js applications, some of them integrating Azure AI services.
Designed and tuned the Microsoft SQL Server databases behind business-critical applications.
Set up CI/CD with Azure DevOps and Jenkins, with automated unit and end-to-end tests.
Worked with cross-functional teams to align technical solutions with business goals.

pt.title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack
pt.stack: NestJS, Next.js, GraphQL, REST APIs, SQL Server, Azure, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Kubernetes

items: Construí APIs REST e serviços GraphQL com NestJS, incluindo melhorias de desempenho em resolvers e consultas.
Projetei as APIs GraphQL do My Team Dashboard, que reúne indicadores de negócio, e publiquei seus microsserviços no Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Desenvolvi aplicações Next.js, algumas integradas a serviços de IA do Azure.
Modelei e otimizei os bancos Microsoft SQL Server de aplicações críticas para o negócio.
Montei CI/CD com Azure DevOps e Jenkins, com testes unitários e de ponta a ponta automatizados.
Trabalhei com times multidisciplinares para alinhar as soluções técnicas aos objetivos do negócio.
